nodes.label: ConsoleScreen (mentor console)
nodes.rationale: Gates on a completed first-year diagnostic (em.firstyear.v1, stage result + selected archetype) and redirects to /first-year otherwise; persists chat + dossier under em.console.v1, preserves per-skill confidence drift across rebuilds, and consumes a ?seed= query param exactly once to auto-send a first message.

nodes.label: AssessmentPage (/first-year/assessment)
nodes.rationale: Loads AssessmentScreen via next/dynamic with ssr:false so localStorage-backed lazy state initializers are safe on first render.

nodes.label: AssessmentScreen (stage machine)
nodes.rationale: Four-stage flow (intro, chat, questions, results) persisted under em.assessment.v1; a persisted chat stage is deliberately not resumable mid-conversation and restarts from intro because partial chat state cannot be rehydrated safely.

nodes.label: ChatOnboarding (Arya chat, module 1)
nodes.rationale: Client proceeds with a null profile if the extract API fails — onboarding completion is never blocked on the LLM.

nodes.label: ModuleRunner (modules 2-7)
nodes.rationale: Module 2 (aptitude) is timed per question with an auto-advance deadline; elapsed seconds are recorded per question to feed a speed bonus in scoring.

nodes.label: ResultsDashboard
nodes.rationale: Renders archetypes, Holland code, aptitude, VARK, values, and a pressure gauge where some dimensions (clarity, authenticity, adult support) invert color logic because high is healthy.

nodes.label: ChatBubble (console message)
nodes.rationale: In admin view, user messages render as an encrypted-lock placeholder instead of content — the visual proof of the member-privacy guarantee.

nodes.label: ChatInput (console composer)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the composer entirely in admin view — admins cannot see or send messages in a member session.

nodes.label: Dossier Panel (live dossier sidebar)
nodes.rationale: Admin view anonymizes deliberately: identity becomes a cohort ID, skill levels round to the nearest 10%, signals hide, and copy states a minimum cohort size of 5 for reports — a privacy-by-design demonstration.

nodes.rationale: Empty by default — milestones are generated per-user from the first-year diagnostic via /api/roadmap/generate; exists only as a typed fallback before hydration completes.

nodes.label: FLAGS Counsellor Thresholds
nodes.rationale: Thresholds gate safety interventions: alignment gap > 60 or anxiety > 70 mandates counsellor referral; Adult_Support_Score < 30 triggers the parent module; Suppression_Detection_Score > 60 flags a suppressed career preference.

nodes.label: Graphify PreToolUse Bash Hook
nodes.rationale: Intercepts grep/rg/find/fd/ack/ag commands and injects a reminder to consult graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md first, steering agents to the knowledge graph instead of raw file scans.

nodes.label: Next.js Breaking-Changes Agent Rule
nodes.rationale: The bundled Next.js version diverges from model training data, so agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ guides before writing code and heed deprecation notices.

nodes.label: Graphify Workflow Rules
nodes.rationale: Prefers graph traversal (graphify query/path/explain) over grep for cross-module questions because the graph carries EXTRACTED + INFERRED edges; requires graphify update after code edits to keep the graph current at zero API cost.

nodes.label: POST /api/assessment/extract
nodes.rationale: Clerk-authenticated Gemini (gemini-2.5-flash) endpoint that turns the 10-question Arya onboarding transcript into a structured student profile JSON; low temperature 0.2 and responseMimeType application/json for deterministic extraction.

nodes.label: extractionPrompt (Arya profile extraction)
nodes.rationale: Embeds per-question extraction_note guidance from the shared question bank so the LLM infers generously and returns one flat JSON profile object.

nodes.label: buildPrompt (M mentor console prompt)
nodes.rationale: Composes the boardroom system voice, the live dossier, and optional first-year diagnostic context; instructs the model to append a <<<DOSSIER>>>...<<<END>>> single-line JSON (skill_deltas, new_signal) so the client can mutate the dossier without a second API call.

nodes.label: POST /api/roadmap/generate
nodes.rationale: One endpoint serves two actions: generate (6 milestones 2026-2032, first is status current) and replan (what-if scenario producing alt milestones while locked past milestones stay fixed).

nodes.label: attachShapes
nodes.rationale: Assigns alternating left/right timeline sides and offsets replan ids by 100 so alt-trajectory milestones never collide with original milestone ids on the client.

nodes.label: Claude Design Handoff Bundle README
nodes.rationale: Explains that test/project/ is an HTML/CSS/JS design prototype exported from claude.ai/design, to be recreated pixel-perfectly in the production stack rather than copied structurally.

nodes.label: Executive Mentor export bundle (self-contained 1.8MB build)
nodes.rationale: Bundler-generated standalone copy of the prototype with all src/*.jsx inlined; same app as the shell versions, packaged for single-file viewing.
